rows.label: qst610401_msg0002
rows.name:
Here, let me tell you a rumor
that's on everybody's lips
in the Imperial Capital.

rows.label: qst610401_msg0003
rows.name:
Late at night, ghosts party at the
Full-Belly Canteen in the Old
Industrial District and make a racket.

rows.label: qst610401_msg0004
rows.name: You don't believe it, do you?

rows.label: qst610401_msg0006
rows.name:
It's not just one or two people who've
heard the ghosts' strange cries.

rows.label: qst610401_msg0007
qst610401_msg0008
rows.name:
He ran back crying, 'I feel sick—like
something's about to come out of my
stomach!'

rows.label: qst610401_msg0009
rows.name:
If you don't believe me, go check it
out yourself.
